question: how cancer cell response to anti-caner drugs

ingredients.name: answer_critical_0
ingredients.criterion: The answer identifies mechanisms by which cancer cells develop resistance to anti-cancer drugs, including genetic mutations that alter drug targets, enhanced drug efflux via overexpressed transporters, and activation of alternative survival signaling pathways.
examples: Genetic mutations can alter drug targets and render therapy ineffective
Cancer cells overexpress efflux transporters that pump drugs out
Activation of alternative survival pathways allows cells to evade drug effects

ingredients.name: answer_critical_1
ingredients.criterion: The answer distinguishes between universal gene expression changes and cell-type specific transcriptional responses to anti-cancer drugs, using high-throughput transcript profiling to characterize responses across cancer types.
examples: Some drug-induced gene expression changes are shared across cancer cell types
Different cancer cell types show unique transcriptional responses to the same drug
High-throughput transcript profiling enables systematic comparison of drug responses

ingredients.name: answer_critical_2
ingredients.criterion: The answer links gene expression response patterns to the molecular determinants of drug sensitivity and resistance.
examples: Common transcriptional signatures may predict drug sensitivity
Cell-type specific expression programs underlie differential drug resistance

ingredients.name: answer_critical_3
ingredients.criterion: The answer explains that the cell cycle and checkpoint control machinery are key targets of anticancer drugs.
examples: Anticancer drugs target cell cycle regulators and checkpoint proteins
Checkpoint control is a major class of anticancer drug targets

ingredients.name: answer_critical_4
ingredients.criterion: The answer states that disrupting cell cycle and checkpoint processes inhibits cancer cell proliferation and induces programmed cell death (apoptosis).
examples: Cell cycle disruption triggers apoptosis in cancer cells

ingredients.name: valuable_0
ingredients.criterion: The answer frames drug resistance as a major challenge in cancer therapy requiring comprehensive understanding.
examples: Drug resistance remains a central obstacle to effective cancer treatment
A comprehensive view of resistance mechanisms is needed

ingredients.name: valuable_1
ingredients.criterion: The answer integrates resistance mechanisms, transcriptional response variation, and cell cycle targeting into a coherent account of how cancer cells respond to anti-cancer drugs.
examples: Drug response involves both resistance mechanisms and cell-cycle-mediated death
Sensitivity varies by cell type while resistance can arise through mutations and efflux
